name: shape-lang
description: Language support for Shape - syntax highlighting and LSP integration
author: Daniel Amesberger

shape.inlayHints.enable.description: Master toggle for Shape inlay hints. When false, suppresses every category below.

shape.inlayHints.typeHints.description: Show inferred type hints on `let` bindings.

shape.inlayHints.parameterHints.description: Show parameter-name hints at call sites.

shape.inlayHints.variableTypeHints.description: Show inferred variable types where elided.

shape.inlayHints.returnTypeHints.description: Show inferred return-type hints on `fn` declarations.

shape.inlayHints.chainHints.description: Show intermediate-type hints on method-chain expressions.

shape.inlayHints.bindingStorageClass.ena.description: Shape-unique: show LSP-side approximation of BindingStorageClass (Direct / UniqueHeap / SharedCow / SharedAtomic / SharedAtomicMut per ADR-006). Default OFF — opt in only if you want to see storage-class inference.
